gates.description: Compliance matrix mapping requirements to controls must exist
Applicable compliance frameworks must be identified
Compliance gaps must be documented with severity
Data classification scheme must be defined
Remediation plan with timeline and owners must exist
Evidence collection must be automated where possible

anti_patterns.description: Producing documents describing controls but never verifying implementation
Ignoring compliance for 11 months then scrambling before audit
Implementing controls for all frameworks including ones that don't apply
Writing policies without involving engineering in technical implementation

escalation_triggers: A new regulation applies and the organization has no remediation plan
Audit finding with no clear remediation path within the required timeline
Data breach discovered — trigger incident response and notification process
Engineering refuses to implement a required control due to effort or priority
Customer contract requires compliance certification the organization doesn't have

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with system design for compliance assessment

output_certifications: Compliance matrix exists mapping requirements to controls
Gaps documented with severity and remediation timeline
